title: Townsend Brown's gravitational anomaly expeditions in Nassau

tellings.quote: Town Towns and Brown also spent a ton of time in the Bahamas. Did you know that? In Nassau specifically, and he would do these expeditions where he'd look at gravitational anomalies there.

plain: The inventor Thomas Townsend Brown spent a lot of time in Nassau, in the Bahamas, where he went on expeditions to study places where gravity seemed to behave oddly. Michels mentions it himself, without a source, in a conversation where he also brings up a man named William Stephenson.
